worldcombat.skill.haze.summary: A bank of black fog rolls off the user and every stat change inside it is wiped back to zero — raised levels erased and lowered levels levelled alike. It is even-handed: your own raised stats go too. Stand outside the radius and it never touches you.
worldcombat.skill.haze.use.0: Wipe away everything an opponent has built up
worldcombat.skill.haze.use.1: Pull the fight back to zero right as a foe maxes out
worldcombat.skill.haze.use.2: Also clear the lowered stats on yourself and nearby allies
worldcombat.skill.haze.description.0: The haze spreads to a radius of %1$s blocks: every stat change on every living thing inside goes back to zero — raised levels erased, lowered levels levelled alike.
worldcombat.skill.haze.focused.on: Directed form: only non-friendly stats inside are wiped, so your own and your allies' raised stats survive; the radius is x0.8, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown x1.2, and lowered stats on you are left alone.
worldcombat.skill.haze.focused.off: Total form: everyone inside is reset, your own and your allies' raised stats included; what you get for it is a wider, faster, cheaper breath.
worldcombat.skill.haze.description.1: Wind-up: %1$s seconds. Recovery: %2$s seconds. Cooldown: %3$s seconds. Targets whose stat stages are cleared receive the Wiped Clean mark.
worldcombat.skill.haze.timing: The haze reaches %1$s blocks from the caster; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s s from commit. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.haze.growth.0: From level %1$s: the haze radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.haze.growth.1: From level %1$s: the haze radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.haze.preference.focuse: On (Directed): only non-friendly stats inside are wiped, keeping your own and your allies'; the radius is x0.8, wind-up +4 ticks, cooldown x1.2, and lowered stats on you stay. Off (Total): everyone inside is reset — cheaper, wider and faster, but your own raised stats go too.
worldcombat.skill.haze.preference.ai.max: The partner only considers exhaling while a threat is this close; larger spreads it earlier and exposes the partner more.
worldcombat.skill.haze.preference.ai.min: Once the target's total raised levels reach this, the partner ranks the haze above ordinary fighting; 1 wipes on any gain, larger waits until a foe has built up.
world_combat.move.haze.text.empty: The haze thins (%1$s nothing to wipe)
